answer: At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a violet tag. The ledge cap is enforced at intake and cedar exposes the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
